answer: Ask what a real person has that a script never will: a past written by others. Firefighter service record with municipal department attestation demands it: each record is years of shift logs and pension contributions in a city system, so a. The delta is the witness list — every entry names a third party who can be asked, and none works for the applicant. One fake needs one complete past; a hundred need a hundred, and the tundra is the bill for all of them. The walnut is the registry check, done in seconds.
